name: Dale on the new ceiling tube
notes: PLAY-31-34 (14 November). Played by FS47Calm once, the evening after the day shift replaced a tube that burned out of age (FS47FreeformSession::TubeRemarkDue), between 19:00 and 23:00, not at the wheel and not over anything else. Dale's dry word over the walkie. No finding, no danger.

beats.text: Day shift says one of your ceiling tubes went in the night. They put a new one in. Tubes cost money. Do not stare at them. Over.
